notes_for_editor: Thin record. Forest Lookouts gives only the header (Washington County, Clark National Forest, 38N-1W-36), a 1955 newspaper item that names a 'Floyd Fire Tower road', and the status Removed. OpenStreetMap gives the point, elevation 428 m and the observation-tower tag. No build date, builder, staffing or fire history was found, so the story leaves those out. The FFLA Missouri page is marked 'Under Construction - Data being compiled' and was not used. Topo and map sites returned 403 or were not read. The brief's 'agency' value mixes a location code into the agency name and is corrected.
